Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip end-effector pose fixed while establishing a grasp on the can. freeze_position enforces the current fingertip world position within the requested 0.01 m tolerance. freeze_orientation preserves the current fingertip orientation; 5 degrees is encoded as approximately 0.087 rad. object_grasped represents closing the fingers until the can is physically held. The detailed requirements about individual left/right finger joint values decreasing toward 0.0, detecting finger contact/effort feedback, and stopping when joint decrease stalls due to contact are not directly expressible with the available operators or condition labels; they are abstracted by object_grasped. close_gripper is not emitted because the API instructs not to emit both close_gripper and object_grasped, and this stage requires a real grasp.
